steps.content: The darkness is absolute, the void endless—you can't even be certain an exit exists at all.
But then, in the distance, you spot a flame—a feeble one that could flicker out at any moment, yet it fills you with a familiar warmth.
It takes you a long time, and at last, you reach the flame.
A girl stands there, cradling a torch in her arms, smiling at you.
Firelight begins to radiate from her body as she extends her hand towards you.
